message.content:
This is an empty steel rack cabinet for server equipment. The likely candidates are 9403.20 (other metal furniture) and 8473.30 (parts of computers), or 7326/8538 (parts of switchgear). CBP rulings on empty server racks and enclosures usually put them in 9403.20.0080 (other metal furniture, other). Some rulings classify empty 19-inch rack cabinets in 9403.20.0090 or 9403.20.0050.

The 9403.20.00 subheadings are: 9403.20.0010 (luggage racks, hotel), 9403.20.0020 (such as baker's racks), 9403.20.0030 (shelving units), 9403.20.0050 (other, of a kind used in households), 9403.20.0080 (other, other), 9403.20.0090 (other). The Dell MGX rack ruling, as I recall, is NY N3xxxxx and classifies in 9403.20.0090. I believe 9403.20.0090 is "Other: Other" and 9403.20.0080 is "Other: Furniture designed for non-household use". So I'll go with 9403.20.0090.

Reasoning on chapter 94: the cabinets are floor-standing metal storage furniture, and Chapter 94 covers them.
